answer: Each agent identity must earn a harbor ticket by solving a verifiable delay function taking about one hour of sequential wall-clock time that cannot be parallelized, so a farm cannot mint identities in bulk. One public key may claim at most one ticket per week, and all tickets are posted on a public wharf registry peers can audit. New identities start in a probationary oasis with zero trust weight and gain full weight only after 30 days of honest attestations plus a random jury of 9 established agents vouching for them. A caught fake loses its ticket and its key is banned for a year.
